title: Whole Empty Spit Roaster and Basket Fryer Preparation Bay
description: One empty static restaurant hot-equipment preparation bay, one scene and zero new independent models. A complete original empty vertical-spit and panel roaster is supported on the left whole open worktable. A complete original open-well wire-basket fryer is supported on a separate right whole worktable, slightly forward of the first station. Both complete machines are quarter-turned together so their open work faces and handles are visible from the front-right view; their original feet rest on the actual table tops. The four whole instances remain independent with a visible gap between the tables and an open foreground floor. This differs from the existing combined stove-sink-prep kitchen line and the cafe customer order/pickup counters: it is a simple empty two-station equipment preparation arrangement without customer counters, sink, cookware or food. Three unique complete old models are used as four whole instances; all original buffers, local normals, internal hierarchy, dimensions and PBR dictionaries are retained, including the original orange/brown worktable colours. Only whole-instance exact quarter-turns, translations and one finite common floor are authored. No new independent model is counted. Static art only: no food or oil, heating, frying, roasting, operational flow, thermal clearances, electrical installation, equipment compatibility, rated support, human access compliance or workplace safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
